channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade Upends Plans and Adds Costs for Marching Bands
item.description: Nine marching bands were set to perform in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade. The decision to move the event to Saturday posed new logistical challenges for them.

item.title: NPR: Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 12,000 cases as some responders evacuate
item.description: As the fast-moving outbreak continues to spread in eastern Congo, fighting between rebels and the army is disrupting efforts to contain the spread of the disease.

item.title: BBC News: Huntingdon train attacker found guilty of all 14 counts of attempted murder
item.description: Anthony Williams, 33, is convicted of 10 attacks on a train and four in Peterborough and London.

item.title: Al Jazeera: Peru burns more than 10 tonnes of seized drugs
item.description: Peru began burning 10.7 tonnes of seized narcotics in its seventh and final drug disposal operation of 2026

item.title: Ars Technica: Ford unveils the GT41 as it hopes to win Le Mans again
item.description: Ford enters the World Endurance Championship in 2027 with the new prototype.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: A Journey Through the Absurd Hell of Trump’s Third-Country Deportations
item.description: How a Thai-born, US-raised Cambodian refugee ended up a prisoner of Africa’s last absolute monarch.

item.title: WIRED Science: Octopuses Use a Multi-Step Process to Squeeze Into Tiny Spaces
item.description: This flexible movement could potentially be applied to the design of soft robots that operate in confined spaces.

item.title: WIRED Business: Meta Refused to Share Muse for Testing, UK Financial Watchdog Complains
item.description: The FCA warned against “another force of attack” from agents after the company declined a request to work on joint testing ahead of rolling out its personal agent in the UK on Tuesday.

item.title: The New Yorker: The Price of an Iranian Life
item.description: A new documentary explores blood money and the persistence of patriarchy.
